reviewer: Codex visual imagery review; human approval pending
selectionMethod: Purposive visual selection from satellite surface texture, then paired seasonal RGB and NDVI review. Footprints fixed before inspecting per-sample numerical threshold results. Labels are imagery interpretations, not field observations.
evidenceSource: Earth Engine saved script andheri-west-core-dry-season-2026-candidates; Google satellite basemap at zoom 18 (acquisition date unknown), paired Sentinel-2 seasonal RGB/NDVI thumbnails with identical outlined footprints.

samples.notes: Broad light roof interior including a roof seam; no visible vegetation inside the footprint. Adjacent tower shadows remain outside. Seasonal RGB is light grey and NDVI low.
Interior grass patch, moved west and shrunk away from the running track. Green in detailed imagery and seasonal RGB, positive spatially coherent NDVI. Grass, not a tree-canopy label.

Contiguous textured tree crowns between buildings and transport corridor. Shrunken and shifted from the initial building-edge footprint. Seasonal RGB and NDVI confirm vegetation response. Compound ownership/use is not verified.

Continuous dense woody vegetation texture, shifted inward from a scrub/bare-ground edge. No visible water or buildings in the footprint. Seasonal RGB/NDVI coherent. Species, canopy height and possible wetland vegetation type are not established.
Bright contiguous roof surfaces with dark roof fixtures; boundary kept off surrounding trees. Seasonal RGB grey and NDVI low.

Narrow elongated strip across clear transport infrastructure. Replaces a tower-shadowed proposal and is shifted south of the roadside canopy edge. Only about two native 10 m pixels wide; alignment sensitivity is a limitation.
Visible canopy in the upper part and built surface/roof in the lower part. Seasonal RGB and NDVI show corresponding spatial mixture. No assumed numerical target green percentage.
Small roofs, lanes and scattered tree patches. Replaces a high-rise/shadow-dominated proposal. Garden ownership or formal park status not inferred from labels; seasonal NDVI is heterogeneous.
Low-rise roofs with surrounding trees and open compound surfaces. Replaces a pond candidate. Seasonal RGB/NDVI show both built and vegetated components.
Tightly packed small roofs and alleys, avoiding surrounding vegetation. No broad obscuring shadow visible; seasonal RGB heterogeneous grey and NDVI low.

rejectedFootprints.reason: Dry, partly bare field with scattered vegetation; not a clearly vegetated reference.
Northwest building/vegetation edge and reduced edge NDVI. Replaced with smaller interior G2.
Scrub/bare-ground transition, ambiguous as pure green. Replaced with interior G3.
Footprint reached the running-track edge. Replaced with smaller interior G1.
Substantial adjacent-building shadow and roof/transport mixture.
Building- and shadow-dominated footprint with little clear garden area; poor mixed reference.
Pond and water-edge contamination, clearly visible in detailed imagery and masked seasonal NDVI.
Too close to roadside canopy edge; shifted south before calculation.
